purpose: A type-check that exits 0 and checks nothing agents change: its script checks types/ only, not src/. Every command passes, and before rubric 2026-12-beta that was Level 2. Now the audit plants a type error in src/pricing.ts, the file the tests import; the type-check still passes, so the commands condition isn't met and the component stays at Level 1, with a fix to make the type-check cover src/pricing.ts.
